name: keyline
description: Keyline keeps your coding agent's UI in your design system, and proves every change in a real browser before it ships. /keyline init reads your codebase and writes a DESIGN.md in your own token names, with a preset for your reader (editorial, product or expressive), set per area of the product, or the exact Glass system from modimihir.com; audit, smoke, type, color, layout, depth, motion, patterns and polish work through it. Audit scores a screen out of 10; polish works in rounds until it reaches 8. A live guard checks each UI file Claude edits, and npx trykeyline keep records what you decided is deliberate, so nothing raises it again.
